definitions.gloss: redness; erythema; reddening of the skin
definitions.explanation: Abnormal redness of the skin caused by inflammation, irritation, allergy, or infection. A medical term used in clinical descriptions and pharmaceutical instructions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧⟦{部位|ぶい}→部位：14458_bui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発赤|ほっせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Redness can be seen at the injection site.

examples.japanese: {発赤|ほっせき}や{腫|は}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you notice redness or swelling, please consult a doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発赤|ほっせき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{痒|かゆ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: An allergic reaction caused redness and itching on the skin.

notes: A medical term frequently seen in clinical reports, drug information leaflets, and patient instructions. Often listed alongside other symptoms like {腫脹|しゅちょう} (swelling), {疼痛|とうつう} (pain), and ⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧ (fever). Common collocations: {発赤|ほっせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧ (redness is observed), {発赤|ほっせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伴|ともな}う→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧ (accompanied by redness). In everyday language, {赤|あか}み (redness) or ⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become red) are more common.
